remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing title and date as above [The Barns, Lake George]. Side of slate grey barn with two small white windows. At left, end of another grey barn & end of small red building. Foreground pale green." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: O'Keeffe⠡n abstract composition of interlocking cubes and triangles across the surface of the canvas clearly delineates the forms of the barns, even the specific details of a broken window.  Sectional views of three barns with pitched roofs, overcast sky with clouds in background, abstracted foreground of green and white.
